from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentFacts(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document relevant to matching with result options."""
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellants, applicants, or parties mentioned in the dispute")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Specific case numbers referenced in the document (e.g., original case numbers for retrials)")
    court_fees: list[str] = Field(description="Court fee amounts mentioned in the judgment result (e.g., '52400 元')")
    monetary_damages: list[str] = Field(description="Specific monetary compensation or penalties awarded (e.g., '15000 元')")
    specific_orders: list[str] = Field(description="Specific performance orders (e.g., 'repair house', 'revoke judgment')")
    ruling_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Key phrases describing the outcome (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '驳回复议申请')")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the judgment")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Nature of the case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentFacts]
